lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  by_contra hne
  rw [funext_iff] at hne
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx0⟩ := not_forall.1 hne
  -- the continuous function `x ⟼ ⟪f x, f x₀⟫` is positive on a ball around `x₀`
  have hi : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) :=
    Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f x₀) hf continuous_const
  have h0 : 0 < ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg'
      (fun h : (0 : ℝ) = ⟪f x₀, f x₀⟫_ℝ => hx0 (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp h.symm))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hpos⟩ : ∃ δ > (0 : ℝ), ∀ x ∈ Metric.ball x₀ δ, 0 < ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp
      (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hi.continuousAt h0)
  -- smooth bump function `φ` with `support φ = ball x₀ δ`
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ, half_lt_self hδ⟩
  have hs : Function.support (⇑φ) ⊆ Metric.ball x₀ δ := le_of_eq φ.support_eq
  have hp : 0 < φ x₀ := φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ)
  -- the test function `g x = φ x • f x₀`
  let g : Y → V := fun x => φ x • f x₀
  have hgf : IsTestFunction g :=
    IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const
  have hI : ∫ x, φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0 := by
    have h := hg g hgf
    simpa [g, inner_smul_right'] using h
  have hc : Continuous (fun x => φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ) := φ.continuous.mul hi
  have hnn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ := fun x =>
    if hx : φ x = 0 then by simp [hx]
    else mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hpos x (hs (Function.mem_support.mpr hx))).le
  exact (ne_of_gt (integral_pos_of_integrable_nonneg_nonzero hc
      (hc.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
        (φ.hasCompactSupport.mono (Function.support_mul_subset_left _ _)))
      hnn (mul_ne_zero hp.ne' h0.ne'))) hI
